extracted.name: Whipped Cottage Cheese
extracted.description: This whipped cottage cheese recipe is a delicious high-protein snack or appetizer! Easy to make in 5 minutes with 5 simple ingredients, it's creamy, tangy, and perfectly smooth. Enjoy it as a dip with crackers and veggies, or try one of the other serving suggestions in the blog post above.
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil (plus more for drizzling)
Chopped fresh parsley (dill, and/or chives, for garnish)
instruction_lines: In a food processor, place the cottage cheese, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, and salt. Pulse until creamy.
Transfer to a serving bowl and top with a drizzle of olive oil, fresh herbs, lemon zest, and red pepper flakes. Serve with crackers and veggies.
